name: The Rundown AI
tagline: The Rundown AI is a daily email newsletter covering the most important AI news and developments in short, focused summaries without padding or filler. It is read by hundreds of thousands of subscribers who want to stay current on AI research, tools, and industry moves without spending hours across multiple sources. Each issue covers new model releases, product launches, funding announcements, and notable research papers in a format you can get through in a few minutes.
